thread:
harper: Quick postmortem follow-up for the weekend spike. Goal: close remediation items and reduce duplicate pages from fanout alerts. I dropped a tiny tracker: https://go.redwood/pm-closure-sprint. Please claim an item by EOD Wed. :clipboard:

jin: I'll own the alert dedupe work. Plan: add `dedupe_key=resource_id`, start with a 10m suppression window, and run a 14d historical comparison. ETA Wed COB.

celine: I'll take threshold tuning for the affected API routes. Proposal: move to p95/p99 rules with `for: 3m`, split `warning` vs `page`, and disable auto-paging for `warning` while we iterate. ETA Thu.

marta: I'll coordinate a 24h canary in one region and build a Grafana panel that compares old vs new trigger counts. Will also add synthetic checks to ensure suppression doesn't hide failovers.

ops-bot: Task created: PM-4712 "Deduplicate fanout alerts + threshold split" assigned to @jin, @celine, @marta, due 2026-04-10.

harper: Checklist before close: 1) owners in tracker (claimed) 2) PR with rule diffs + rollback (owner: jin/celine) 3) canary dashboard (marta) 4) runbook blurb for oncall rotation (harper) 5) follow-up in next retro.

jin: I'll open the PR tonight and include a small suppression simulation script in the repo. Posting PR link here when ready.

celine: I'll draft the percentile rules and include a query to compare triggers before/after for 7d.

marta: Created simplest dashboard (panel + threshold comparison) and linked synthetic run results in the tracker.

harper: Great. If any blocker mark the tracker item blocked and ping me. We will review in Friday standup and close items once PR merged and canary stable. :white_check_mark:
